notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Hello Jans!

We are coming back with some more minor bugfixes, which you reported recently. Thank you for your ongoing feedback via tickets and forums! It helps us improve yours and future Jan's journeys!

[p]Check the full changelog below:  

[h3]Story/Quests: [/h3]

[list]
[*] [spoiler] ACT2 - Disease rebellion is not properly cancelled after MRI scan if the player ignored it [/spoiler] 
[*] [spoiler] Alters refuse to work if the player removes the module where the Radiation Phobia story started [/spoiler]
[*] Alter Rebellion dialogue is getting stuck in a specific scenario
[*] [spoiler] Black screen after transitioning chapters with Miner having Heavy Injury [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] If Miner dies in the Workshop, he is considered alive until the player observes him. Now we know how that cat felt. [/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]Other:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Black screen after ACT2 or Interlude in a specific scenario
[*] [spoiler] ACT3 - Alters sometimes not reaching the Sarcophagus if the path is too long [/spoiler]
[*] Sometimes, the "Jan Complete" achievement only unlocks after opening Lessons Learned from the pause menu
[*] [spoiler] A Scientist is permanently assigned to an Infirmary bed if he left the base while being heavily irradiated [/spoiler]
[*] Crash when going to the main menu while hovering the map cursor over a structure with a controller
[*] Alters rotating at the start of dialogues
[*] Landscape quality drops when the user looks towards the base if Texture Quality is set to High or Ultra in 4K
[*] [spoiler] ACT3 - Parts of the tree are not visible after scanning the interferences [/spoiler]
[*] Mustache appears with a delay during dialogues
[*] Multiple minor performance and gameplay issues
[*] Minor collision issues during exploration and in the base
[*] VO, SFX, and subtitle adjustments
[/list]

Take care!

~ 11 bit studios Team

notes.title: Community Update #2 - Vinyl Pre-Order, Your Content, and Current Plans.
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Jans! 

Recently, our Discord and Reddit have been literally taken over by Jan Dolskis. Our community continues to grow with new Jans, and you can't even imagine how moved we are by this. In addition, we receive so many positive words and reviews from you, which makes us really proud and motivated to continue this adventure together. And believe us, there's much more to come! Thank you!    

As this is our second Community Update, we want to dedicate it to you - Jan Dolskis. [b]There will be couple of art from you, vinyl pre-order, and our next goals[/b].   
[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Vinyl pre-order is available![/h3][p]That's right! Right now you can [url="https://blackscreenrecords.com/products/the-alters?srsltid=AfmBOopWXoGv7L1bYOTtToEM7V0Nq8lhnkTZvqcPzIjiXO0VxeaiodKT&variant=51600594731274"]pre-order[/url] amazing The Alters OST composed by Piotr Musiał, on a Vinyl. 

Available in clear and beautiful Rapidium-inspired, multi-coloured splatter: 
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/9fce08652cc33487febd5dda9ae26f01bdc9f3c2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/128cb44e9f50793dd36ff1e5de3c60dd27484fed.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Tracklist:

SIDE A[/b][/p][p]A01. The Alters Theme[/p][p]A02. How Did I End Up Here?[/p][p]A03. Home Far Away[/p][p]A04. Rapidium Theme[/p][p]A05. Project Dolly[/p][p]A06. Molten Echoes[/p][p]A07. Running in Circles[/p][p][/p][p][b]SIDE B[/b][/p][p]B01. The Last Stretch[/p][p]B02. Magnetic Storm[/p][p]B03. Alternate Lifepaths[/p][p]B04. The Prism[/p][p]B05. Getting Ready[/p][p]B06. As Piotr once said: “While many sci-fi soundtracks these days favor the sound of analog synths, the idea behind the music of The Alters was a bit different. Now you will be able to take part of the story to your home!

We see your posts and artwork that you publish on our [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/TheAlters/"]Reddit[/url] and [url="https://discord.com/invite/11bitstudios"]Discord[/url]. Believe us, each one of them touches our hearts. <3 We couldn't show all of them, but we encourage you to visit our community channels to witness them by yourselves!  

Below you will find just a glimpse of amazing piece of your art:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Made by [url="https://www.reddit.com/user/fionabasta/"]u/fionabasta[/url][/b][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/ad3015e1ab50754d2f5331fad3bab70d3e03e494.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/523cd2cb8fe96af65fdcacdbef81e0e7d144a902.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Plans for now[/h3][p]We are currently working on addressing your feedback in the upcoming update - 1.3.0, which will resolve most of the recent issues you have encountered. Thank you so much for your ongoing support, which helps us improve your journeys, and journeys of future Jan Dolskis! 

You also know that we are working on DLC and we have some more suprises for you in the future! We cannot wait to be able to tell you more about them, so stay tuned! 

Aaaand that's all for today, take care on your extraterrestrial adventures Jans.   

See you soon!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Jans!  [/p][p][/p][p]We are launching first Hotfix to address majority of the most popular issues, which you have reported so far.[b] [/b]We are very grateful for your ongoing feedback, which helps us improve your experience from the game!  [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the details below [b](MAY CONTAIN SPOILERS!)[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s gone:[/b][/p][list][*][p]No more getting stuck in Guard conversations.[/p][/*][*][p]Alters won’t block your progression by not going to Arc Sarcophagus on the final day.[/p][/*][*][p]Alters refusing to work will no longer remain stuck in that state in new playthroughs. If you’re already affected, please load a save from before the issue started to resolve it.[/p][/*][*][p]No more infinite narrative loops causing stutters, black screens, or save issues (especially in Act2).[/p][/*][*][p]No more black screens or missing daily saves when you’re close to a rebellion and move to journey / new act for new playthroughs. We are still working on a fix for the existing playthrough.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]DLSS Framegen and FSR3 not working - [/b]Fixed an issue where mentioned features were unavailable on the Game Pass PC version of the game. (Note that users who have V-Sync turned on might need to switch it off and on again for Framegen to become available)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Guard Conversation Softlock - [/b]Fixed an issue where talking to the Guard about surveillance could lead to a softlock, if you hadn’t triggered the early conversation before. The problematic dialogue now always completes correctly and no longer blocks progress.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Alters Not Moving to Sarcophagus - [/b]Resolved an issue where, in some cases, Alters (especially Miner) would not move to the Arc Sarcophagus on the final day of Act 3.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Alters Refusing to Work Forever - [/b]Fixed an issue where an Alter (e.g. the Botanist) who refused to work due to an ignored request would stay in that state forever after transitioning from Act 2 to Act 3. This state will no longer happen in new playthroughs, but users already affected by this issue will need to reload a save from before the issue began. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Narrative System Infinite Loop - [/b]Addressed a bug where certain narrative systems would loop indefinitely, causing performance drops, framerate stuttering, black screen during day transitions and various problems with save files. The fix should resolve all of these issues. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Journey Black Screen and Missing Saves - [/b]Fixed an issue where starting the Journey with less than 24 hours left before a rebellion could cause a permanent black screen and prevent daily saves from being created in later chapters. The Journey now starts correctly and daily saves are generated as expected for new playthroughs but users already affected by this issue will need to reload a save from their last journey. We are still working on a fix for the existing playthrough. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Additional minor improvements[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Alters Release Date Revealed
notes.notes:
What if survival means facing the versions of yourself you never became? What if you chose family over going to college? What if your girlfriend from high school became your wife, and what if you actually lost her?

[previewyoutube=WF48QDkg3Cw;full][/previewyoutube]

Revealed today as part of the 2025 Triple-I Initiative, we announced that [b]The Alters will launch on June 13, 2025![/b]

Stranded on a hostile planet and racing against a deadly sunrise, Jan Dolski’s only chance of survival is to create “alters” - alternate versions of himself shaped by decisions he didn’t take. Each Jan is a separate personality - with unique skills, habits, and memories tied to their different life choices. But they also come with flaws, doubts, and emotional baggage.

Your success means managing yourself, literally. You must maintain a mobile base, make time-critical decisions, build relationships with your alters, and confront the consequences of their own past lives. Sounds easy, right…? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/479ee8ff9eca43af1763f6e378747382cf7d5231.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/a6ed4db39c0965a8a4cd8ecc0b11e1240af084e1.jpg[/img]

A new mechanic revealed in the trailer - which wasn’t shown before, introduces various [b]deadly anomalies![/b] Mysterious phenomena which will stand in your way during planet exploration - we’re talking levitating rocks, eerie distortions, heightened radioactivity, and other threats which sometimes won’t be visible for you without special tools. 

[h3][b]!! BE CAREFUL !![/b][/h3]

In every case, without cautious approach, you risk instant death, radiation-induced injuries, or even disintegration of time and space itself. And, if that wasn’t enough already, the heightened radioactivity can melt your suit. These dangers add yet another layer to the survival experience, turning every expedition into a high-stakes puzzle. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/43d55c9867505078d96205fe4e76c6995b9cd893.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/7a69498b31f5a85cac0c73a4829d50fd6307f31d.jpg[/img]

Witness it by yourselves on [b]June 13.[/b]

Mark your calendars and stay tuned for upcoming news!

Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/11bitstudios and subreddit r/TheAlters
